timing: Freeze the larger-sample diagnostic before grading the new 48-fit outer panels. A four-class latent correction improved over the original single tree by 5, 2 and 5 rows on the original training feedback panels. Its mixture with the stronger research reference lost on one confirmation, so the original election did not promote it.
implementation_note: The first protocol described centered offsets. Its first implementation applied zero-centered L2 shrinkage but did not explicitly enforce zero weighted mean across latent classes. Preserve that result under uncentered. In the centered implementation project each context coefficient across classes so its class-prior-weighted mean is zero on every joint objective evaluation. Compare both on the development panels and the larger packets; use the original uncentered four-class model as the prespecified primary large-sample diagnostic. The centered method is a separate secondary comparison and has no automatic release right.
larger: Use all three fresh outer packets already in the 48-fit study. Generate five train-only, group-held original-tree probabilities for each complete fitting packet. Reuse verified pipeline artifacts only when their candidate id, entire training and scored feature/label arrays, row order and metric agree with the required split. Train missing tree components and record them individually. Reuse the already frozen full-tree outer probability file. Fit a four-class expectation-maximization correction separately for each centering regime on each packet. Freeze all six predictions before any outer grades. Evaluate actual corrected and worsened rows against the original constituent, the teammate's ordinary 48-fit agent and the current expanded ordinary agent.
decision: A primary candidate becomes eligible for experimental ordinary catalogue integration only if the pooled gain is at least .003, at least two of three folds improve and none drop by more than .003 against all three references. Changes to the ordinary mainline would still need independent autonomous selection evidence. Truth on these new evaluation partitions can be used only after all admissions and forecasts are locked. Historical research had used some of these course-training rows; this is not a hidden course test.
